name: a first boot goes straight into confirmed, turns the cursor live and checks the digest
a boot records a thin dead derived row as a spent id and keeps it out of confirmed
a boot over confirmed rows fills staging and leaves confirmed as it was
staging replaces the confirmed rows and their digest when the boot cursor turns live
a page requested under an older cursor is dropped as stale
reset sets the cursor to null and keeps the confirmed rows for the next boot
gone forgets the scope and resolves its acked entries; its pending entries stay
not-found marks the scope known not-found
live rows replace confirmed rows, a dead row deletes and a new row enters
a live row older than the confirmed row is ignored; a newer one replaces
a page ending inside a seq resolves acked entries only through the seq before it
the page that finishes the seq resolves the rest
a boot that ends resolves acked entries through its asOf
a digest mismatch at the head emits telemetry and resets the scope
the boot after a mismatch reset restores the rows and its check matches
a mismatch on the first check after a mismatch reset stops checks at this app version
stopped checks skip at the same app version and resume at a new one
the next frame with rows applies inline and checks the digest
a frame past the next seq asks for a pull
a frame without rows asks for a pull
a frame of another epoch asks for a pull
a gone frame forgets the scope
a response of a new epoch changes epoch first, and its pages, requested under old cursors, are stale
